exposure: Scarred uteri from a previous caesarean section
Labour induction with prostaglandins or prostaglandins combined with oxytocin
cohort: The study included 1,441,712 maternities from women giving birth in 21 maternity units in Norway during the period 1967-2008.
finding: The incidence of uterine rupture in Norway increased sharply over the 40-year study period, with obstetric interventions contributing significantly but not entirely explaining the increase.
mod_finding: Scarred uteri from a previous caesarean section was identified as a significant contributing factor to the increased incidence of uterine rupture.
